interface.shortDescription: Sharper Slack messages, emails, and memos.
interface.longDescription: A collection of practical agent skills by Kinanti Desyanandini. Currently includes refine: a written-communication editor and coach built on Wes Kao's frameworks (bottom line up front, minimum viable backstory, signposting, most obvious objection, finesse, the warm no, and more), applied by audience (CEO, cross-functional, peers, customers) and format (chat, email, marketing copy). Includes a voice-doc template so rewrites sound like you, not like AI. Attribution: these skills restate other people's frameworks in original wording — the ideas are theirs. The bulk of refine is Wes Kao's work (newsletter.weskao.com); every source is credited in the repo's CREDITS.md. Independent and unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by the people credited. If a framework helps you, go support its author.
interface.defaultPrompt: Refine this draft for me — tell me who it's for, then paste your Slack message or email.
